sourceProjection.basis: The published numbered general project plan was visually checked as an overhead plan. Its low resolution and inclusion of planned structures remain separate limitations, not corrected by assuming another projection.

review: TRIANGLE POSTALS publisher's book sample, printed page 255, visually checked orthographic architectural project plan. Black architectural ink is in image 92; numbered labels are separate PDF text. Pale surrounding site marks and the photographic model are excluded. Published project layout includes future elements, not a claim of current completion or access. No tower or crypt floor inferred from this ground plan.
limitations: 本图为建筑规划主层平面，包含荣耀立面、洗礼堂等规划部分；不代表所有区域已建成或开放。
柱列、侧廊、后殿和原图全部重复编号均保留。小尺度细节受原始平面图分辨率限制，墙高仅用于显示。
地下教堂、受难立面塔及登塔通道的独立楼层平面仍待核验；不以主层复制成其他楼层。

rasterLayers.reason: Reviewed dark architectural walls and columns including antialiased edges; the blue ground field has maximum channel >= 143. Pale site markings are not walls. Source labels are outside this image stream.
